prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save your pet to your account", "Sign in now so your chosen desktop pet and settings are safely synced to the cloud."]
1: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Learn the basic shortcuts to summon, move, or hide your companion anytime."]
2: ["Bringing your pet to life...", "Desktop Tip: Use Ctrl+Alt+P if your pet ever hides behind active windows."]
3: ["Pick Your Companion", "Select a ready-to-play instant companion or upload custom photos for a bespoke pet.", "Adopt Instant Companion (Ready Immediately)"]
4: ["Signing in links your pet to your account so progress and customizations are never lost.", "Create or log into your account to securely store your companion's identity."]
5: ["Test Your Pet Controls", "Try these desktop actions now to make sure your companion is visible and responding properly.", "Press Ctrl+Alt+P to toggle visibility | Click pet to open menu | Speak to pet via mic/chat"]
6: ["For best 3D pet results, upload well-lit photos facing forward without obstructions.", "Good photos yield realistic 3D desktop pets. Avoid dark or blurry images."]
7: ["Your Live Desktop Companion", "Adopt an interactive pet that walks, plays, and stays on your desktop while you work."]
8: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Name your companion and review their adoption certificate before generation.", "Name your pet"]
9: ["Having trouble signing in? Click below for connection troubleshooting or guest options.", "Troubleshoot Sign-In"]

verdicts.problem: Suggests guest options to bypass or get around the required sign-in step.
